import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):

    th=np.tanh(p[9]*t)
    return p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*t**2+p[3]*th+v*(p[4]+p[5]*t+p[6]*t**2+p[7]*th)+p[8]*x
